derivation: O(dx,dy)=max(|dx|,|dy|)+(sqrt(2)-1)*min(|dx|,|dy|). Linked rear: O(anchor-DIN)+O(DIN-rear)<=(300-front-63-15-25-14)/1.15. Shared reference: same sum<=(300-25-14)/1.15. OCT: O(header-shared)<=(300-front-63-15-7)/1.15; no DIN. Triangle inequality gives necessary endpoint octagons. Each eight inequalities n dot translation <= radius+n dot(centre-originalpad) is explicit. Euclidean ellipses are a looser necessary comparison, not used to weaken octile budgets.
limit_classification: 300mm and1000pF are retained project acceptance/allocation rules here, not measured failure thresholds. A334mm model does not prove unsafe hardware; a300mm model does not guarantee safe or stable hardware. This study does not establish their original empirical rationale or waive them.
limitations: Domains omit bodies, common-contact injectivity, collisions, occupied volumes, power/return topology and routed capacitance.
Shared island has30 whole packages; this necessary translation domain checks65 electrical rows only, not whole-island mechanical clearance.
OCT source movement is included: its30 paths are recomputed, never silently left unchanged.
Separate cluster domains assume every other group fixed; they are not a certificate of simultaneous joint feasibility.
All nine aggregate shared capacitances remain unextracted; 1000pF direct budget unchanged, receiver dynamics separate.

locality_comparison.no_regression_definition: Every rear nonrail net maximum pair span <= its baseline, every bypass supply-pad leg <= baseline and dedicated two-leg sum <= baseline. Simultaneous componentwise comparison; no scalar benefit offsets a worsening timing/feedback/reference metric. Rigid translation/rotation preserves within-cluster spans; intercluster spans still require recomputation.
